title: On Turning the key in the old lock
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：turn　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 turn 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the builder ① turned the key in the old lock in public, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② turns the key in the old lock in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ turn the key in the old lock at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ turned the key in the old lock before — a line in the plan for October 1971 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Turning the key in the old lock in public, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ turn cold towards the end of October in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Turn cold towards the end of October at once and never mention it again.

By 1984 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ turns cold towards the end of October in public every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ turned the key in the old lock again when nobody else would.

⑩ To turn the key in the old lock, my mother said in 1989, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody turns the key in the old lock in silence again and somebody must turn the key in the old lock in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 转身（一般过去式 turned the key in the old lock：1977 年施工员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 转身（一般现在 turns the key in the old lock：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 转身（不定式 to turn the key in the old lock：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 转身（过去完成时 had turned the key in the old lock：1971 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 转身（动名词 turning the key in the old lock 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 变成（turn cold towards the end of October：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去变成十月末开始转冷）
G. v. 变成（turn cold towards the end of October：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 转身（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 turns cold towards the end of October，而母亲又一次 turned the key in the old lock）

answers.why: turn 意为“转身”，1977 年施工员当着众人面转身转动旧锁里那把钥匙，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 turned。
turn 意为“转身”，自那以后施工员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 turns。
turn 意为“转身”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯转身转动旧锁里那把钥匙”，此处为不定式 to turn the key in the old lock。
turn 意为“转身”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1984 年之前就有人转身过，故用过去完成时 had turned。
turn 意为“转身”，施工员说“转身转动旧锁里那把钥匙这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 turning the key in the old lock 作主语。
turn 意为“变成”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去变成十月末开始转冷”，should ever 之后用原形 turn cold towards the end of October。
turn 意为“变成”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻变成十月末开始转冷（turn cold towards the end of October at once），以后再也不要提起。
turn 意为“转身”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例变成十月末开始转冷，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 turns。
turn 意为“转身”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面转身转动旧锁里那把钥匙，用一般过去式 turned 叙述。
turn 意为“转身”，结尾那句是母亲 1989 年的话：要转身转动旧锁里那把钥匙，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

Somebody had turned the key in the old lock long before 1984, and the line in the plan for October proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 turn 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the builder turned the key in the old lock in public, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder turns the key in the old lock in silence whenever the site asks.
Turning the key in the old lock in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever turn cold towards the end of October in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site turns cold towards the end of October in public every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother turned the key in the old lock again, and the site remembered that half.
